title: Bacterial Detection & Identification Using Electrochemical Sensors
protocol: Prepare the thiolated capture probe at a concentration of 0.05 μM in 300 μM 1,6-hexanedithiol (HDT), 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.3 M NaCl, 1 mM EDTA.
Incubate the thiolated capture probe with HDT for 10 min in the dark at room temperature.
Apply a stream of nitrogen to bare gold sensor array chip(s) for 5 sec to remove moisture and/or particulates.
Apply 6 μl of the HDT-thiolated capture probe mix to the working electrode of all sensors on the sensor array.
Store the sensor chip(s) in a covered Petri dish at 4 °C overnight.
Wash the sensor chip with deionized water for 2-3 sec the following day.
Dry under a stream of nitrogen for 5 sec.
Apply 6 μl of 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.3 M NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM 6-mercapto-1-hexanol (MCH) to the working electrode of all sensors.
Incubate for 50 min in a covered Petri dish at room temperature.
Transfer 1 ml of bacterial culture in the log phase of growth (OD600 ≈ 0.1) to a microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 5 min.
Remove the culture supernatant.
Thoroughly resuspend the bacterial pellet in 10 μl of 1 M NaOH by pipetting up and down several times.
Incubate the suspension at room temperature for 5 min.
Neutralize the bacterial lysate by adding 50 μl of 1 M Phosphate Buffer, pH 7.2, containing 2.5% bovine serum albumin (BSA) and 0.25 mM of a fluorescein-modified detector probe.
Incubate the neutralized lysate for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash the MCH from the sensor chip with deionized H2O for 2-3 sec.
Dry under a stream of nitrogen for 5 sec.
Apply 4 μl of neutralized bacterial lysate to the working electrode of each of 14 sensors.
Incubate for 15 min.
Apply 4 μl of 1 nM bridging oligonucleotide in 1 M Phosphate Buffer, pH 7.2, containing 2.5% BSA and 0.25 μM fluorescein-modified detector probe to 2 positive control sensors.
Incubate for 15 min.
Wash the sensor chip with deionized H2O for 2-3 sec.
Dry the sensor chip under a stream of nitrogen for 5 sec.
Apply 4 μl of 0.5 U/ml anti-Fluorescein-HRP in 1 M Phosphate Buffer, pH 7.2, containing 0.5% casein to the working electrode of all 16 sensors.
Incubate for 15 min.
Wash the sensor chip with deionized H2O for 2-3 sec.
Dry the sensor chip under a stream of nitrogen for 5 sec.
Apply a film well sticker to the surface of the sensor chip.
Load the sensor chip into the sensor chip mount.
Pipette 50 μl of TMB substrate onto all 16 sensors.
Close the sensor chip mount.
Obtain amperometry measurements for all 16 sensors using the Helios Chip Reader.
Obtain cyclic voltammetry measurements for all 16 sensors using the Helios Chip Reader.
